records.name: Anjali Rajpal

sources.label: Beverly Hills Dental Arts — Meet Dr. Rajpal

narrative.text: Anjali Rajpal leads Beverly Hills Dental Arts, a practice offering cosmetic and general dentistry. Her practice biography connects her interest in painting and sculpture with the visual detail involved in dental work.

The biography lists dental training at Tufts University and a general practice residency at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center. It also describes further cosmetic training with Esthetic Professionals in Tarzana.
Outside dentistry, the biography mentions painting, playing the sitar and hiking—interests that add an individual perspective to her professional story.

records.name: Kevin Frawley

sources.label: Beverly Hills Dentistry — Dr. Kevin Frawley

narrative.text: Kevin Frawley practices at Beverly Hills Dentistry, where his biography emphasizes cosmetic dentistry and implant care. It lists his UCLA dental graduation in 1982, followed by a residency at the Veterans Administration Clinic in Westwood.
His practice biography also describes his work founding Surgical Esthetics and Helping Hands Surgical Mentoring, connecting his clinical work with dental materials and professional education.
The biography says he works alongside his children, dentists Michele and Shawn Frawley, and enjoys gardening and tending a koi pond.
